task: Phase H security - incident SEC-2026-09-14-01, an InfluxDB token published in a public repository: audit, rotation of the consumers, deactivation, repository cleanup and anti-leak barrier
session_mode: Denis working directly over SSH, scripts written by Dust, rehearsed offline before delivery, no OpenClaw delegation

incident.what: an organisation-wide InfluxDB authorization was readable in this public repository, published by the 15-minute log auto-commit
incident.closed_influxdb_side: 2026-09-15, authorization deactivated - the published value no longer authenticates anything
incident.aggravating_factor: the exposed authorization declared write access on authorizations, so it could also create or deactivate tokens
incident.note_on_values: this file never contains a token value; tokens are referenced by the first 16 hex characters of their sha256 only

note_on_this_record: written before its own commit existed, so it cannot contain its own SHA; that SHA is appended to logs/oc-actions.log by the same script
deployment: no service restarted, no container restarted, no data written to the production bucket by this phase
commit_chain: 265bb857e1e2  H1b read-only audit of the InfluxDB authorizations and their consumers
fb73946746ff  H2a rotate the signalk-to-influxdb2 token away from the exposed one
548ee128e63d  H2b recreate the grafana container so the provisioned datasource gets a real token (health ERROR -> OK)
860120398157  H3a deactivate the exposed authorization and the orphan token, nothing deleted, reversible
this commit    H3b untrack the two files carrying the value, install the anti-leak barrier, correct the written record
defects_closed: 12 the exposed value remained in two tracked files - files untracked in H3b
13 the H2b v1 Flux probe used count() on a time column - rewritten without aggregate
15 the H2b v2 RESULT line over-claimed that Grafana never held the exposed token - corrected by addition in H3a
16 the H3a report printed a hardcoded HTTP 401 instead of the observed HTTP 404 - corrected by addition in H3b
17 the 401/403 log grep matched digits inside nanosecond timestamps - corrected by addition in H3b
18 the claim that the two files were not covered by .gitignore was false - corrected by addition in H3b
defects_open: 14 the H2b v2 DEBUG line in logs/oc-actions.log is split in two by a grep -c || echo 0; documented, not rewritten
19 the exposed value remains in the git history, deliberately not rewritten
20 Grafana still accepts its default admin password and anonymous access is enabled
21 influx auth list prints every token value in clear to anyone who can docker exec
22 a Grafana alert rule (mr-safety-network) queries a bucket weather_lis that does not exist, so that alert is silent
next_steps: H3d, after a day of observation: permanently delete the two deactivated authorizations and the three unused Grafana-* org-wide tokens
harden Grafana: admin password, anonymous access
give Grafana a read-only token instead of the shared read+write one
